card.name: Novelty and breakthrough in science writing
card.fires_on: Words in science news, book titles and citations that frame work as new, first or revolutionary, such as "New" in a title, "first" before a discovery, or "reveals". It also fires on nearby linking words in these phrases.

modes.label: Novelty in titles
modes.description: The word New or a title word that signals a fresh view or a historic turn.
modes.example: Cycles of Time: An Extraordinary<< New>> View of the Universe

modes.label: Discovery claims
modes.description: Words announcing a first result or something newly shown in research news.
modes.example: researchers are reporting the<< first>> detailed molecular snapshots of a deadly gastrointestinal virus

modes.label: Citation and title links
modes.description: Verbs and linking words inside paper titles and reference lists.
modes.example: Time-resolved electron tomography<< reveals>> how the plasma membrane is reshaped during

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning new, breakthrough and revolution, including Chinese terms for brand-new.
card.plain: It lights up where science writing announces something new, a first, or a breakthrough.
